subject.title: Exploring a chat-first Android surface for OpenClaw (discussion + possible focused upstreaming)

question: Should this Android-specific chat-first proposal stay open in this repository, move into the broader mobile RFC discussion, or be narrowed to one concrete Android PR slice?
rationale: Current main partially improves Android chat access, and a newer mobile design RFC appears to own broad mobile directions, but maintainers still need to decide whether this Android-specific fork evidence should stay as source-repo follow-up.

options.title: Keep open until RFC routing is confirmed
options.body: Preserve this Android-specific evidence until maintainers confirm whether the draft mobile RFC is the canonical venue or define narrower Android slices here.

options.title: Close in favor of the RFC venue
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm the draft mobile RFC is the intended place for chat-first Android direction and fork references.

options.title: Sponsor direct chat-first mode
options.body: Adopt this as the tracking issue for a chat-first Android mode and require onboarding, upgrade, media-permission, and release proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep open until RFC routing is confirmed
recommendation.body: Preserve this Android-specific evidence until maintainers confirm whether the draft mobile RFC is the canonical venue or define narrower Android slices here.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Android chat/media work and the adjacent mobile design RFC/product review path.
